books.json.description: three l2Book snapshots per coin, top 5 levels, taken at fetch time (spread and depth now, not historical)

candles-15m.csv.gz.description: 15 m candles, latest 5000 per coin (Hyperliquid serves no older 15 m bars); the last bar of each coin was still forming at fetch time and is dropped by the loader
candles-15m.csv.gz.request: candleSnapshot {coin, interval: 15m, startTime: now - 5000 x 15 min, endTime: now}
candles-15m.csv.gz.used_for: Task 007B calibration (entries up to 2026-10-27) and Task 007C in-sample; 2026-10-28 onwards is the hold-out (30 Oct pilot day)

funding-1h.csv.gz.used_for: funding costs of the 15 m sets (hours before 2026-10-11 use the coin mean)

meta.json.description: szDecimals and maxLeverage of the six markets

oos-candles-1h.csv.gz.description: 1h candles (latest 5000 per coin; Hyperliquid serves no older bars)
oos-candles-1h.csv.gz.used_for: Task 007C out-of-sample: entries before 2026-09-09 only (never used to choose the parameters)

oos-funding-1h.csv.gz.request: fundingHistory paged from the first 1 h bar
oos-funding-1h.csv.gz.used_for: Task 007C out-of-sample: entries before 2026-09-09 only (never used to choose the parameters)

note: Public Hyperliquid market data, no credentials. Checked by lib.mts before every run: a changed file stops the run.
